summary: Partial fix only: ordinary GDN prefill mixed-dtype execution passes, but the MIS prefill path retains the original Triton dtype compilation failure and the new helper corrupts the PAD_SLOT_ID=-1 cache row.

tests.what_was_measured: On recorded base, reproduced index_put dtype errors on CPU and gfx950 for FP16/BF16, BF16/FP32, and BF16/FP16 source/cache combinations.
At exact candidate commit, candidate regression passed four dtype combinations and compared GPU output/cache state with an independent grouped-conv1d reference.
Candidate focused suite: 18 tests and 27 subtests passed.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python <prepared-python> inline MIS causal-convolution boundary reproducer
tests.what_was_measured: Harness confirmed two expected candidate failures: BF16 activations with FP32 and FP16 conv caches both raised Triton CompilationError on the direct call still used by _forward_mis_segments.
Direct kernel preserved the -1 padded cache row; candidate mixed-dtype helper changed it (maximum absolute delta 4.28125), triggering the assertion.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 ran the candidate numerical regression and both adversarial cases with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015.

remaining_counterexamples: GDNAttnBackend._forward_mis_segments bypasses _causal_conv1d_with_cache_dtype; BF16 activations with FP32 or FP16 conv cache still fail Triton compilation with a new_conv_state branch type mismatch.
_causal_conv1d_with_cache_dtype converts PAD_SLOT_ID=-1 into a dense identity index, processes the padded row, and writes it into conv_states[-1] instead of preserving the skip contract.
remaining_limitations: QuantTrio/Qwen3.6-27B-AWQ weights were unavailable, so full-model serving and semantic accuracy were not tested.
The available GPU was AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 with ROCm 7.2, not the reported RTX 5090/SM120 with CUDA 13.3.
No native source changed in the candidate, so native rebuild was not applicable.
